# The Tour

This is a *short* document that shows **every** kind of block `tui-markdown` draws.
It has a [link to the second chapter](#second-chapter), a [sibling file](other.md#deep-end),
and an [external site](https://example.com/docs?a=1&b=2).

## Second Chapter

```python
def fib(n):
    return n if n < 2 else fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)
```

### Unicode

日本語のテキストは空白がなくても折り返されます。中文也是一样的,没有空格。
Emoji 🎉 and a combining é (e + U+0301) stay whole.
